title: Append application instructions
description: Adds application-authored instructions to the running session. Never carries project text or caller text.

event_id.description: The broker's correlation ID for this command. It returns as client_event_id on the answering event.

delegation_id.description: A client delegation ID the provider has already announced, or null for session-wide context. The provider answers an unknown ID with invalid_request_error on param delegation_id.

content.description: Plain text. maxBytes is a KalaReach keyword bounding the string in UTF-8 bytes. The provider's limit is 500 tokens, which the broker cannot count without the provider's encoder; 500 UTF-8 bytes is at most 500 tokens under a byte-level encoder, so the broker's bound holds the provider's without counting. The provider answers invalid_value on param content if it is ever exceeded anyway.
